name: Bestial Defense
body:
Wearing the skin of beasts brings you good health and luck.

Prerequisite: Mahrog.

Benefit: While gaining the benefit of the skin of the beast racial trait, you also gain a +1 resistance bonus to your Reflex and Fortitude saves.

Check out the Random Weather Generator!
